Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.layout

Class JsonLayout

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.layout.JsonLayout
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogLayout
public final class JsonLayout extends Object implements LogLayout
The JsonLayout class implements the LogLayout interface and formats log entries into a JSON format.

  • Constructor Details

    • JsonLayout

      public JsonLayout(boolean propertiesEnabled, boolean locationInfoEnabled, boolean stacktraceEnabled, int maxStringLength, String truncatedStringSuffix)
      Constructs an instance of the JsonLayout class with the specified configuration parameters.
      Parameters:
      propertiesEnabled - whether context information (MDC) should be included in the JSON log output.
      locationInfoEnabled - whether location information (source file and line number) should be included in the JSON log output.
      stacktraceEnabled - whether stack trace details should be included in the JSON log output if a throwable is present.
      maxStringLength - the maximum length for string fields in the JSON log output; strings exceeding this length will be truncated.
      truncatedStringSuffix - the suffix appended to truncated strings to indicate truncation.
